audit.whatIsWrong: Rows 3, 5 and 6 disagreed with the shape the mirror already settled (Lucian owns Levels 1 through 6; Mundo takes first item and 2+ items).
audit.why: That is the classic scaling-tank curve and it matches whys[5] and whys[6]; the shipped rows had 4-5 as Skill and 2+ items as Lucian, which is backwards for a drain tank.
audit.corrected: Row 3 to Lucian, rows 5 and 6 to Dr. Mundo, matched pairs, ratings mapped to the mirror's scale inverted (8/8/8/7/8/4/2).

audit.whatIsWrong: Level 6 was treated as a wash and the item spikes carried no numbers.
audit.why: Maximum Dosage is a flat 120s that instantly heals a percent of MISSING health then regenerates a share of max health — burst cannot race it, and no armour purchase is relevant. Heart Zapper is 17s at rank 1 and heals off stored damage.
audit.corrected: Spikes now name the 120s ult, the 17s zap and the first-health-item turn.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page repeatedly cited "Adrenaline Rush" — not one of his abilities — and never mentioned the passive's CC resist or Blunt Force Trauma's auto reset.
audit.why: His passive is Goes Where He Pleases: it resists the FIRST immobilizing effect, costs him health, and drops a cannister he can walk over to heal and cut its cooldown. Blunt Force Trauma (9s to 6s) is an auto reset scaling with his missing health. Infected Bonesaw is a 4s, 975-range current-health cleaver — it out-ranges Lucian's 500.
audit.corrected: Adrenaline Rush removed, the CC-resist and reset tells added, and the 975-vs-500 range gap stated.

edits.before: Level 1-2 is the only stretch you truly own — your auto range plus the Lightslinger double-tap after a Q lets you chunk Mundo before he has E's bonus damage or his cleaver-heal economy running. Hit your Level 2 Q and dish a brutal double-shot trade. But respect his Q cleaver — every axe he lands not only pokes your squishy base HP, it heals him via his passive when it expires, so dodging it is half the matchup. By Level 3 his Adrenaline Rush regen starts eating your poke faster than you can apply it.
edits.after: Level 1-2 is the stretch you own outright — your auto range plus the Lightslinger double-tap after a Q lets you chunk Mundo before Blunt Force Trauma's bonus damage is online. Hit your Level 2 Q and dish a brutal double-shot trade. Respect Infected Bonesaw: a 4-second cleaver at 975 range that scales on your current health and slows, and it out-ranges your 500, so dodging it is half the matchup. And never open with CC — Goes Where He Pleases eats the first immobilise and drops a cannister that heals him.

edits.before: From Level 3 onward the lane slips. Mundo's passive heals and percent-HP Q poke let him facetank your double-shots and regen it back, and his E gives him enough damage that you can't sit in trade range freely. Use your W mark and E dashes to weave pokes and back off, but do not commit to extended fights — he wins anything that goes past the first burst. At 6 his Maximum Dosage R is a wall you can't break, even with The Culling. Your real mid-game value is leaving the lane with E and snowballing elsewhere.
edits.after: From Level 3 onward you have to be precise. Heart Zapper (17s) stores a share of the damage you deal and heals him when it bursts, so anything long refunds him, and Blunt Force Trauma is an auto reset that grows as his health drops. Weave pokes behind the Ardent Blaze mark and step out before the zap expires — he wins everything past the first burst. At 6 Maximum Dosage instantly heals a percent of his missing health on a flat 120s, so never spend The Culling into it. Leave with E and snowball elsewhere.

edits.before: This is a lost cause 1v1. Mundo with health items, Adrenaline Rush regen, and Maximum Dosage is functionally unkillable to your physical-damage burst — The Culling tickles him and he heals it instantly. You are a weak scaler for an ADC top and he scales forever, so the gap only widens. Your only path to relevance is having already converted your Level 1-2 dominance into a lead and ended the game before his items come online. If you didn't, group, kite him with W move speed, and let your team's percent-HP/anti-heal handle the drain tank.
edits.after: This is a lost cause 1v1. Mundo with health items and Maximum Dosage is functionally unkillable to your physical burst — The Culling tickles him and a flat 120-second ultimate heals a percent of his missing health straight back. You are a weak scaler for an ADC top and he scales forever, so the gap only widens. Your only path was converting Level 1-2 dominance into a lead and ending before his items land. If you didn't, group, kite with the Ardent Blaze move speed, and let your team's percent-health damage and Grievous Wounds handle the drain tank.
